tools.name: check_performance
tools.description: Check what slows a URL down, without running a browser. Times the server response as a regular browser (time to first byte, compression, caching, redirects, HTTP/3), reads the HTML for render-blocking scripts and stylesheets, third-party scripts, the main image (lazy loading, preload, weight), image

tools.name: check_security
tools.description: Check the basic, passive security of a URL: HTTPS and whether the http:// address redirects to it, Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy (and whether it really limits scripts), clickjacking protection (frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options), X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, cookie

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Run every Sharelint check on a URL at once: link previews in 12 apps, AI visibility for ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, iOS and Android app links, performance, and security basics. Use it for a general "check my website or link" request; use the focused tools when the question is about one of these.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_security" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_link_preview, check_ai_visibility, check_app_links, check_performance, check_security, check_url · Private data: check_app_links · Public sink: check_security · Destructive: check_link_preview, check_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_link_preview, check_ai_visibility, check_app_links, check_performance, check_security, check_url · Private data: check_app_links · Public sink: check_security · Destructive: check_link_preview, check_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
